purpose: Operational placement rules for assigning any new symbol, tradition, figure, realm, route, institution or archive object to the Potato House without inventing a new floor or conflating function with moral value.
placement_questions: What is it in its own source/tradition?
What category is it: terrain, regime, organism, material, threshold, perceptual layer, process, route, inhabitant, coordinate, standing plane or whole?
Which plane(s) can a reader usefully encounter it from?
Does it genuinely participate in Roots, trunk, Life, Strife, canopy, Repair or Return?
Is it a structural node, an inhabitant/subject, or merely a comparative neighbor?
What typed corridor connects it to existing nodes?
What must it not be confused with?
Should it be landmark, room-detail or archive-only?

family_rules.rule: Treat a heaven/celestial realm as a tradition-specific cosmographic subject. World stores its texts, rites and historical reception; Heaven Plane is the comparative reader projection.
family_rules.do_not: Do not turn every divine realm into the Potatoverse Heaven Plane.

family_rules.rule: Anchor in the tradition's own death/afterlife cosmography; World stores texts/history, Below exposes descent/death/root functions.
family_rules.do_not: Do not equate underworld with punishment, evil, Hell or Tree of Strife unless the specific tradition supports it.

family_rules.rule: World trees are high-value vertical connectors. Compare branching/rooting/function while preserving each tradition's cosmology.
family_rules.do_not: Do not silently rename external world trees as the Potatoverse Tree of Life.

family_rules.rule: Mountain placement emphasizes integration, orientation, encounter, ascent/descent or world-center roles according to source.
family_rules.do_not: Do not infer holiness or truth simply from height.

family_rules.rule: Treat as built ordering regimes with gates, rooms, ritual access, civic or sacred functions.
family_rules.do_not: Do not equate city, temple, House and Garden merely because they overlap structurally.

family_rules.rule: Use for inward passage, burial, testing, hidden center, route-finding or emergence when the source supports it.
family_rules.do_not: Do not create a new Below floor for every descent image.

family_rules.rule: Place by function: boundary, memory, purification, nourishment, death-crossing, source or return.
family_rules.do_not: Do not treat all water as Spirit/CSF or all rivers as one universal river.

family_rules.rule: Gates are state/context-changing access points. Record guardian, admissibility rule, direction and consequence where source provides them.
family_rules.do_not: Do not call every transition a strong Door without a real state/context change.

family_rules.rule: Use as support/orientation/mediation comparators. A staff/pillar may carry messenger or threshold functions without becoming the central Axis.
family_rules.do_not: Do not flatten Jachin/Boaz, caduceus, world axis and tree trunk into one object.

family_rules.rule: Place only by tradition-specific role: guardian, adversary, wisdom, renewal, chaos, medicine, world-boundary, death or transformation.
family_rules.do_not: Do not assume serpent = evil, kundalini, Satan or Spiral across traditions.

family_rules.rule: Messenger/psychopomp placement follows the source tradition's movement between realms and roles.
family_rules.do_not: Do not make all messenger figures angels.

family_rules.rule: Own-tradition demonology first; Tree-of-Strife comparison only when capture/distortion/repetition functions are actually relevant.
family_rules.do_not: Do not map real people or disliked groups to literal demons.

family_rules.rule: Treat as authority/order/office symbols whose legitimacy, service, succession and limits must be source-specific.
family_rules.do_not: Do not infer moral superiority from rank or vertical height.

family_rules.rule: Separate astronomical object, historical astrology, religious symbolism and project mapping into typed layers.
family_rules.do_not: Do not treat symbolic correspondence as physical causation.

family_rules.rule: Map judge, standard, evidence, gate, outcome and repair/return where present.
family_rules.do_not: Do not flatten all afterlife judgments or legal systems into one ledger.

family_rules.rule: Use Seed/Spiral routing only after the source tradition's own death/return sequence is described.
family_rules.do_not: Do not label every seasonal or funerary cycle as the Potato Seed of Death/Life.
